name: Sakura no Toki -Sakura no Mori no Shita o Ayumu-
original_name: サクラノ刻－櫻の森の下を歩む－
source:
Geniuses, the talented, and the ordinary. Weak gods and strong gods. A story that goes beyond happiness, and even further still. This, indeed, is the second act of the Sakura story.

A genius chosen by the gods, a talented person abandoned by the gods, and an ordinary person who defies the gods.
What is the charis that dwells in beauty? Why is its fruit given only to the chosen?

“Where did we come from? Who are we? Where are we going?”

A world bound by the light of causal exchange. Can artists, through beauty, answer that question?

[spoiler] The story centers on Naoya Kusanagi after the events of Sakura no Uta, following the final landscape Naoya and Ai saw while descending from the slope overlooking the city of Yumihari.

Until then, many untold stories remained.
Two geniuses. The true story behind Kei Natsume and Naoya Kusanagi.
Why do they continue to captivate people as artists, even after death or after putting down the brush?
Rin Misakura, a painter who is the very embodiment of beauty. Why does she try to go beyond the point where they stopped?
What about Rina Hikawa, Yuumi Kawachino, Makoto Toritani, and Ai Natsume? [/spoiler]

The thoughts of all humans intersect.

[From [url=https://moe-gameaward.com/title/detail.html?id=9016]Moe Game Awards[/url]]
translation:
天才、才华横溢之人，以及普通人。软弱的神明，以及强大的神明。一段超越幸福、还要继续向前的故事。这正是樱花故事的第二幕。

被神明选中的天才、被神明抛弃的才华之人，以及违抗神明的普通人。
美之中寄宿着怎样的魅力？它的果实为何只赐予被选中的人？

“我们从何而来？我们是谁？我们将去往何方？”

这是一个被因果交换之光束缚的世界。艺术家们能否通过美回答这个问题？

[spoiler]故事围绕《樱之诗》之后的草薙直哉展开，承接直哉与藍在俯瞰弓张市的坡道上走下时所见的最终景色。

直到那时，仍有许多故事从未被讲述。
两位天才，以及夏目圭与草薙直哉背后的真实故事。
即使死去或放下画笔，他们为何仍以艺术家的身份持续吸引着人们？
身为美之化身的画家御桜稟，为何试图超越他们停下脚步的地方？
还有氷川Ruriwo、川内野铃菜、鸟谷真琴与夏目藍呢？[/spoiler]

所有人的思绪彼此交错。

（来源：[url=https://moe-gameaward.com/title/detail.html?id=9016]萌系游戏大赏[/url]）
